The '''Oniantae Hills''' was a hilly region on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon]] of [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]]. It separated the forests of the [[Jiberah Plains]] to the west from the [[Mertuen Forest]] to the east and south. It also bordered the [[Yawari Cliffs]] to the north. The [[Moon/Legends|moon's]] [[Smuggler Outpost]] was located in the Oniantae Hills.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:OniantaeHills2.jpg|thumb|left|180px|[[Smuggler Outpost]]]]
The Oniantae Hills were one of many designated planetary regions in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
